subject: Approval requested: Emma Thompson - Senior Infra SWE offer (exception request)
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval requested: Emma Thompson - Senior Infra SWE offer (exception request)

Hi team,

I'm requesting quick approval for an exception on the offer structure for Emma Thompson (hiring manager: Jenna Park, Infra). We are matching a competing offer and need to push slightly above our standard L4 band to secure her. Summary below:

- Role: Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer (L4)
- Headcount: HC-478 (open, approved by Jenna Park)
- Proposed comp (exception): Base $210,000 / Annual bonus target 12% / RSU 0.50% (4-year vest) / Signing cash $20,000 (one-time)
- Standard band (L4): Base $185–195k; RSU ~0.30% typical; signing $0–15k
- Candidate note: Strong infra background (distributed systems, low-latency runtime), competing offer at $210k + 0.4% RSU. Manager recommends higher equity to offset relocation risk.

Attachments: Offer_Letter_Emma_Thompson_v1.pdf, Comp_Committee_Memo_Emma_Thompson.xlsx (breakdown, market comp, justification).

Request: Approval to send this package as-is (base + equity + sign-on) OR indicate changes (cap sign-on, reduce base, change RSU) so we can finalize DocuSign. Legal will need final PDF.

Timing: Candidate asked for response by EOD Pacific today. Appreciate fast replies.

Thanks,
David
David Kim | Head of Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0172
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval requested: Emma Thompson - Senior Infra SWE offer (exception request)

On Fri, May 21, 2027 at 9:12 AM David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'm requesting quick approval for an exception on the offer structure for Emma Thompson...

Thanks David — quick read looks reasonable given the competing offer. I approve the base at $210k, but would prefer we cap the sign-on at $15k unless the manager can justify $20k as relocation vs retention. Please confirm whether any hiring manager stretch bonus or acceleration is planned.

If Manager confirms the $20k is necessary for relocation, I can greenlight it. Otherwise, move forward with $15k and 0.45% RSU (midpoint between our band and ask) if Markus is okay.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Talent & People Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:20:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval requested: Emma Thompson - Senior Infra SWE offer (exception request)

On Fri, May 21, 2027 at 9:45 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks David — quick read looks reasonable given the competing offer. I approve the base at $210k, but would prefer we cap the sign-on at $15k...

I support David and the manager here. Emma will lead a component that reduces inference latency in key customer flows — retention risk is high and replacement cost would be >2x. Approve base $210k. I am comfortable with RSU at 0.50% as an exception for this hire given scope.

Marissa's ask to cap sign-on is fair; however, if the sign-on is explicitly for relocation (documented in offer memo) and not purely cash to entice, I'm okay with $20k. Otherwise, prefer $15k.

Karthik — can you please confirm comp committee sign-off for the equity uplift (+0.20% relative to band) so we can finalize?

-Markus
Markus Klein | Chief Product & Strategy Officer | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval requested: Emma Thompson - Senior Infra SWE offer (exception request)

On Fri, May 21, 2027 at 10:20 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> I support David and the manager here...

Reviewed comp memo and market comps. Approve the exception with one condition: set RSU to 0.45% (middle ground) and approve signing cash $20k only if manager documents relocation requirement in the offer attachment; otherwise reduce to $15k. Base $210k approved.

I have updated the Comp_Committee_Memo_Emma_Thompson.xlsx with the final approved figures (RSU 0.45%, sign-on conditional). Please attach the revised memo and updated offer PDF and route to Legal for DocuSign. Once updated, David please send the offer to the candidate and CC hirefast@talentpartner.com.

Final: Base $210,000 / Bonus 12% / RSU 0.45% (4y) / Sign-on $20,000 (conditional on relocation justification; otherwise $15,000).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Compensation & Talent Programs | Redwood Inference

---
Forwarding: David Kim will circulate the revised PDF + DocuSign link to emma.thompson@example.com and hirefast@talentpartner.com once Legal confirms the document.
